subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@aurelia.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - post-call recap

Hi Daniel

Great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery and the MAP draft I promised to share. I attached a working MAP spreadsheet (named Redwood_MAP_Draft_AureliaTech_20260610.xlsx) — please consider it a starting point we can iterate on. Highlights: 

- Goal / target close: PoC sign + Dedicated capacity contract by 2026-07-31
- Key MAP milestone this week: Security review / SOC 2 package delivery (Aurelia needs questionnaire + evidence to complete internal review)
- Proposed owner for security milestone: Redwood (Marissa) to deliver package, Aurelia SOC to review and confirm; Rishi (SE) and Neha (CS) to provide evidentiary items and follow up on technical questions
- Dependencies: completed network architecture diagram, access instructions for audit artifacts, confirmation of log retention windows
- Proposed dates: Redwood to deliver SOC 2 package by 2026-06-18; Aurelia to confirm review outcome by 2026-06-25

Next steps / asks for you: 
1) Confirm that the SOC 2 package deliverable and proposed dates work for Aurelia (especially the 6/18 delivery date).
2) Share any procurement contacts (if different from cc'd) or required PO template.
3) Let us know if you want any specific evidence prioritized (e.g., encryption key configs, network diagrams).

Attachments in this thread: Redwood_MAP_Draft_AureliaTech_20260610.xlsx (MAP draft) — also planning to attach the SOC2 checklist + sample attestation in a follow-up email.

Thanks

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0198

---
Redwood Inference | Developer-first inference platform for production LLMs

From: Daniel Park <daniel@aurelia.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: SOC Team <soc-team@aurelia.com>, Procurement <procurement@aurelia.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - post-call recap

Thanks Marissa

appreciate the clear recap and MAP draft. A few quick notes from our side: 

- The proposed timeline looks reasonable, but SOC will need the questionnaire + evidence earlier if possible. Can you get the SOC2 package (questionnaire + evidence list) to us by EOD 2026-06-18 as you suggested?
- For evidence, our SOC team will prioritize: attestation, system architecture diagram, access control matrix, encryption details, and log retention policy.
- Procurement: I've cc'd procurement — they prefer we receive the vendor SOC report and standard contract redlines before we proceed to signature. They may push for a 30-day review window.

Two asks: 
1) Please send the SOC2 checklist and a short list of the exact artifacts you will provide.
2) If you can flag any items that will require a deeper technical call with Rishi, please do so — we may request a short follow-up meeting.

– Daniel
Daniel Park
Head of IT Security, Aurelia Tech
daniel@aurelia.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@aurelia.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - MAP + SOC2 package attached

Hi Daniel

Thanks

attaching the SOC2 package and a short evidence checklist per your ask. Files attached as stubs below: 
- Redwood_SOC2_Package_Reqs.xlsx (checklist + proposed evidence list)
- SOC2-Attestation-Excerpt.pdf (public excerpt of our attestation)
- VPC_network_diagram.png (redacted network diagram)

MAP milestone (security review) — proposed details to include in the working MAP: 
- Milestone: Security review + SOC 2 package delivery
  - Owner: Redwood (Marissa) to assemble package; Aurelia SOC to review
  - Deliverables: completed questionnaire (Redwood_SOC2_Package_Reqs.xlsx), attestation excerpt, redacted architecture diagram, access instructions for logs (read-only audit), sample policies (retention, encryption)
  - Target Redwood delivery: 2026-06-18 (EOD PT)
  - Aurelia review completion target: 2026-06-25
  - Dependencies: confirmation of which logs/artifacts Aurelia needs access to (Rishi to coordinate), PO/procurement timeline

Inline answers to your asks: 
1) Exact artifacts we will provide (from the checklist): attestation excerpt, completed checklist answers, redacted network diagram, encryption kms overview, access control matrix extract, log retention policy doc, list of SOC evidence locations with instructions for read-only access.
2) Rishi — items likely to need a deeper technical call: access to audit logs (how we expose read-only S3 buckets), KMS/key management details, and any environment separation questions (VPC peering options). Please flag anything else.

If the dates look good, I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and send a final MAP row with owners/dates.

Best,
Marissa

Attachments (stubs): Redwood_SOC2_Package_Reqs.xlsx, SOC2-Attestation-Excerpt.pdf, VPC_network_diagram.png

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:50:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - internal tasking

Rishi / Neha

forwarding the thread. Please see the SOC2 checklist I attached to Daniel. Action items for us: 
- Rishi: prepare short tech write-up for audit logs access (S3 read-only pattern), KMS configuration summary, and be available for a 30-min call (propose 2026-06-16 or 6/17). Owner: Rishi. Due: 2026-06-16 EOD.
- Neha: gather the customer-facing policy extracts (retention policy doc, access control matrix extract) and redacted screenshots for the diagram. Owner: Neha. Due: 2026-06-16 EOD.
- Marissa: consolidate final package and deliver by 2026-06-18 EOD; update MAP spreadsheet with confirmed dates and owners after you ack.

Let me know if those due dates are tight and we should propose alternate dates to Aurelia.

Thanks

Marissa

From: Daniel Park <daniel@aurelia.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: SOC Team <soc-team@aurelia.com>, Procurement <procurement@aurelia.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft & SOC 2 package delivery - confirmation

Marissa

This looks good. Procurement confirms they can start their review once they have the completed checklist and attestation excerpt. SOC team reviewed the checklist and will prioritize the items you listed (attestation, diagram, access instructions). We can tentatively schedule a 30-min technical call with Rishi on 2026-06-17 at 10:00 AM PT — send invite if that works.

Also: procurement asked if you can include any standard contract redlines you expect — we can get that into their queue.

Appreciate the quick turnaround
looking forward to the package on 6/18.

Regards,
Daniel
